test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the given options arranges the following sentences in the most logical sequence to form a meaningful paragraph?

1. Millions of tourists from all over the world visit it every year.
2. It was built by Emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal.
3. The Taj Mahal is one of the most beautiful monuments in the world.
4. They admire it as an architectural marvel as well as a symbol of love.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph discusses the Taj Mahal, its significance, and its historical context.
 
• **Sentence 3** is the opening statement as it introduces the central idea of the Taj Mahal being one of the most beautiful monuments in the world:
 
 
• "The Taj Mahal is one of the most beautiful monuments in the world."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 2** follows as it explains the historical context and the reason for its construction:
 
 
• "It was built by Emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 1** is placed third as it describes the global admiration and attention the Taj Mahal receives:
 
 
• "Millions of tourists from all over the world visit it every year."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 4** concludes the paragraph by elaborating on why people admire the Taj Mahal:
 
 
• "They admire it as an architectural marvel as well as a symbol of love."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **3-2-1-4**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"The Taj Mahal is one of the most beautiful monuments in the world. It was built by Emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal. Millions of tourists from all over the world visit it every year. They admire it as an architectural marvel as well as a symbol of love."</div
